primary_venue: Journal of Open Research Software, Issues in Research Software
problem: Successful execution and provenance capture do not by themselves show that identified evidence warrants each material scientific claim.
thesis: Agent-assisted computational science needs prospective claim-versioned acceptance contracts and externally enforced, role-scoped state transitions layered over interoperable claim and provenance standards.
contributions: Operational vocabulary separating rerenderability, repeatability, reproducibility, replication, and scientific validity
A prospective claim acceptance contract and externally enforced lifecycle
Claim-version-scoped and revocable attestations with dependency invalidation
An interoperability profile for existing provenance, workflow-run, and claim-publication standards
A bounded reference implementation and explicit validation agenda
prohibited_claims: The current demonstration establishes improved review outcomes
evidence_gates: Every novelty statement appears in the claim ledger
Every citation is verified against a primary or official source
A sanitized protocol version is frozen
An independent reviewer exercises the reference record
The rendered candidate is inspected before release
